title: Area Sales Officer
description:
Job Description: Retail Sales Officer Company Name: Noble Steel (Sangam Steel)
 Job Title: Retail Sales Officer
 Department: Sales
 Job Location: Kozhikode, Salem, Kochi, Namakkal, tuticorin, Chennai, Chengalapattu 
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Reporting To: HOD Website: https://www.noblesteels.com/ 
 Job Summary Sangam Steel is looking for a motivated and customer-oriented Retail Sales Executive to manage retail sales, assist customers, promote steel products, and achieve sales targets. The ideal candidate should have good communication and negotiation skills, a customer-focused approach, and the ability to develop strong relationships with customers, contractors, fabricators, and dealers. 
 Key Responsibilities Attend to walk-in customers and understand their steel product requirements. Explain product specifications, quality, pricing, sizes, and availability. Generate sales leads and convert enquiries into confirmed orders. Prepare quotations, sales orders, invoices, and other sales documents. Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets. Maintain strong relationships with existing customers and develop new customers. Coordinate with the store, warehouse, and dispatch teams to ensure timely delivery. Monitor stock availability and communicate inventory requirements to the concerned team. Handle customer queries, complaints, and after-sales service. Follow up on pending quotations, customer orders, and outstanding payments. Maintain accurate sales records and prepare daily sales reports. Ensure proper product display, store cleanliness, and adherence to company policies. Keep track of local market trends, competitor pricing, and customer preferences. 
 Required Qualifications Minimum graduate degree in any discipline is preferred. 13 years of experience in retail sales, preferably in steel, hardware, building materials, or construction-related products. Knowledge of steel products such as TMT bars, MS angles, channels, flats, pipes, sheets, and other steel items is an advantage. Basic computer knowledge, including MS Excel and billing or inventory software. Good communication, customer service, and negotiation skills. Ability to work with sales targets and manage multiple customer enquiries. 
 Key Skills Retail Sales and Customer Handling Product Knowledge and Sales Pitching Lead Generation and Follow-up Negotiation and Order Closing Billing and Documentation Inventory Coordination Relationship Management Target Achievement 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Achievement of monthly sales targets. Number of new customers acquired. Conversion rate of customer enquiries into orders. Repeat business and customer satisfaction. Timely follow-up on quotations and pending orders. Accuracy of sales documentation and billing. Collection of outstanding payments, wherever applicable. 
 Compensation and Benefits Salary: As per industry standards and candidate experience. Incentives based on sales performance, as per company policy. Training and career growth opportunities. Other benefits as per company policy. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be energetic, trustworthy, proactive, and commercially oriented, with a strong interest in retail sales. Experience in steel trading, hardware, construction materials, or a building materials showroom will be an added advantage.

Key Skills: Marketing,B2B,Direct sales,Retail sales,TMT,Business development,B2C,Sales
